description: This file contains the implementation of a Microsoft SQL Server ADO driver for PHP, including the class ADODB_ado_mssql which extends the base ADODB_ado class. It provides methods for interacting with MSSQL databases, such as retrieving the last insert ID, affected rows, managing transactions, and schema introspection.

classes.name: ADODB_ado_mssql
classes.description: Class providing MSSQL-specific functionalities for the ADO database abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ado_mssql
classes.description: Class extending ADORecordSet to handle record sets specifically for MSSQL.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted identity value in the current SQL scope.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last SQL statement.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level for the database connection.

methods.name: qStr
methods.description: Sanitizes and quotes a string for safe inclusion in SQL queries, replacing null characters.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns in a specified table.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence table for generating unique IDs.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a new numeric ID from the sequence, creating the sequence if it does not exist.
